config.title: Raw config
config.lead: Free-text keys the site reads: the notice, footer and links.
config.caption: Config keys

warning.title: Every value here is public
warning.summary: Anyone can read these values, so never put a secret here; secrets belong on the Settings page.
warning.html: HTML values (announcement, footer) are cleaned before they show on the site.
warning.tracking: Tracking code must be the site operator's own snippet, as given.

config.previewLabel: Preview in an isolated frame (runs no code)
config.previewNote: Script tags, on… event attributes, iframes and javascript: links do not run in the preview; the live page cleans the value when it shows.
config.urlNote: A link key accepts only http or https.
config.trackingNote: Use only the site operator's own tracking snippet, as given.
config.deleteBody: Every page stops using this value at once.

errors.keyPattern: The key needs 1–30 characters, no control characters.
errors.url: A link key accepts only http or https.

config.unusedChip: Old site only: not read here

known.top_notification: Site notice: plain text shown above every page to every visitor until they close it.
known.announcement: Old site: HTML announcement box at the bottom of every page.
known.home_page_top: Old site: HTML block at the top of the home page.
known.footer: Old site: HTML added to the footer.
known.analytics: Old site: tracking script in every page head.
known.meta_description: Old site: the description meta tag of the home page.
known.meta_keywords: Old site: the keywords meta tag of the home page.
known.discord_invite_link: Old site: Discord invite link on the home and login pages.
known.discord_invite_shieldio: Old site: Discord badge image (shields.io) beside the invite.

notice.title: Site notice
notice.lead: A short plain-text message above every page, for signed-in and signed-out visitors alike. Each visitor can close it; a changed text shows again.
notice.label: Notice text
notice.hint: Plain text; line breaks are kept, HTML is shown as typed.
